Roles and permissions

Applicants can access only their own submission and requested documents. Assigned caseworkers can review their cases. Supervisors assign cases and set document retention.

Build prompt

Build “Client & Beneficiary Intake Portal” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Collect the minimum fields for the program. Request proof only when required, use private document links, record document access and show applicants a clear next step. Applicants can access only their own submission and requested documents. Assigned caseworkers can review their cases. Supervisors assign cases and set document retention. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

Request proof of income from applicant A. A sees the request and uploads a fictional file. Applicant B cannot retrieve that file or status. The assigned worker can mark the file reviewed.
